resources.string: The background screen is created as the shell user, so Shizuku (or a compatible AXManager / Sui) must be running and must have authorized Minis. This page never requests the permission itself.
Check the connection and authorize Minis
Leaving this page only stops the preview refresh. The virtual display and the apps on it keep running.
Focus is shared with the main screen

This system rejected the trusted-display flags, so the core explicitly downgraded the display. Input still goes only to this display, but the foreground app on the physical screen may see focus changes.
Size is in pixels, density in dpi (the same unit as wm density). Changing either requires re-creating the display; a live surface cannot be resized.
Width and height must be %1$d–%2$d, density %3$d–%4$d.

The preview refreshes at most 2 frames per second (adjustable 1–8) and stops as soon as you leave this page. A tap sends a tap, a drag sends a swipe; coordinates only ever target the virtual display Minis created.
Launches the app onto this virtual display only. If the app is currently in use on the physical screen, the core refuses to launch it rather than moving what you are looking at.
Text is delivered as key events to the app at the top of the virtual display and supports printable ASCII only. For other scripts, paste through the clipboard instead.
Screen re-created at the new size
Could not create the virtual display
The background screen is not running
Size or density is out of range
This system does not support the requested configuration
That app is in use on the main screen
Input did not reach the background screen
The background screen service disconnected — start it again
Command line for the virtual display Minis owns
Run and control a virtual display through Shizuku
Background-screen CLI: create, screenshot, tap/swipe/key, launch apps and type text. It only ever targets the virtual display Minis created and never falls back to the physical screen.

This switch is separate from Shizuku authorization. Even with Shizuku granted, the agent cannot use the background screen until it is allowed here. Revoking it, or losing the service, releases the display and the preview together.
